# 21 · Gaps in Spectral Gap Literature

- **Area:** Random graphs, random matrices, spectral gap
- **Tracks:** Combinatorics, Analysis

## Description

The first result in this area was an unreadable paper by Joel Friedman. Charles Bordenave wrote a more readable paper but it was still quite hard. Brito-Dumitriu-Harris wrote a yet more readable paper, but relied on a key lemma by Bordenave that they were unable to reprove in an intuitive way (Prop 28 in Bordenave's paper; Lemma 7 in B-D-H). (I haven't fully surveyed the field to see if there are newer papers that make this stuff clearer).

## Reference/source material

Brito-Dumitriu-Harris, 2021: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1804.07808
Bordenave, 2019: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1502.04482
Friedman, 2004: https://arxiv.org/pdf/cs/0405020
Friedman & Kohler, 2014: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1403.3462

## Desired outcome

An intuitive proof of Proposition 28 in Bordenave's paper; a deeper exploration of these papers, intricacies and gaps between them, explanation and commentary/visualizations to help those learning the theory.
